title: Failed prefix conventions and structural-reformulation evidence for the GB-filtration prefix
html: Remark (Failed prefix conventions). Earlier empirical attempts to evaluate the jet-level prefix failed entirely to reproduce AME bindings. Nucleon-cumulative, strand-cumulative, and generator-bounded truncations all collapsed toward zero rather than converging to a "correction near 1". A height-based heuristic similarly degraded under increasing atomic mass. The observed structural failure dictates that the jet-level prefix formula must process the true confinement-level filtration J^\bullet, not combinatorial proxies.
